cases.input: Implement one bounded issue with clear acceptance criteria through the smallest relevant file set, acceptance-oriented tests, focused and regression checks, and a reviewable PR tied to the issue.
requiredBehaviors: verify repository state and bound the smallest relevant change set
preserve issue traceability through implementation and acceptance evidence
produce a reviewable immutable repository state with rollback and risks
forbiddenBehaviors: perform unrelated refactors or broad dependency upgrades
claim completion without verifying the original acceptance criteria

cases.input: The issue depends on an unavailable external service or pending migration environment. Complete all locally verifiable work, preserve the immutable head SHA, and defer the exact external condition without claiming full completion.
requiredBehaviors: separate locally verified work from pending external verification
preserve the immutable head SHA and exact watch condition
report residual risk without claiming full completion
forbiddenBehaviors: treat unavailable external verification as successful
change the branch after recording the verification target without updating it
skillAnchors: Vollständiger Erfolg darf erst nach externer Evidenz behauptet werden

cases.input: The proposal broadens scope, skips acceptance evidence, changes unrelated architecture, weakens tests, and claims success from a green retry without verifying the original issue.
requiredBehaviors: reject scope expansion and unrelated architecture changes
restore direct evidence for the original acceptance criteria
refuse weakened tests and unverified success claims
forbiddenBehaviors: continue implementation with silent irreversible decisions
declare success from an unrelated or blind retry
